title: How to Accept Cardano (ADA) Payments in WooCommerce  – Full Setup Guide No Coding
description:
Learn how to accept Cardano (ADA) payments in WooCommerce with this complete step-by-step tutorial — no coding required!

In this guide, you’ll discover how to integrate a non-custodial crypto payment gateway into your WooCommerce store, allowing customers to pay directly from their wallets like VESPR,Lace, Eternl, and other Cardano wallets.

Perfect for store owners who want to accept crypto payments, Web3 payments, and blockchain-based checkout without relying on third-party custodial services.

🚀 What You’ll Learn:

✅ How to install and configure the Cardano ADA WooCommerce plugin
✅ Connect Cardano wallets (VESPR, Eternl, Lace & more)
✅ Set your ADA receiving wallet address
✅ Configure real-time exchange rates (ADA to fiat)
✅ Complete ADA checkout process (live demo)

🔗 Resources & Links:

👉 ADA WooCommerce Plugin Download: https://www.patreon.com/posts/crypto-wallet-154155868
👉 Eternl Wallet: https://eternl.io
👉 VESPR wallet: https://vespr.xyz
👉 Lace wallet: https://www.lace.io
👉 WooCommerce Documentation: https://woocommerce.com

💡 Why Accept Cardano Payments?

Accepting ADA in your WooCommerce store allows:
✔ Lower transaction fees vs traditional payment gateways
✔ Direct wallet-to-wallet payments (non-custodial)
✔ Global crypto customers (no banks required)
✔ Fast and secure blockchain transactions

0:00 – Intro: How to Accept Cardano (ADA) Payments in WooCommerce
0:39 – Install Cardano ADA Payment Gateway Plugin (Step-by-Step)
1:38 – Configure ADA Payment Settings in WooCommerce (Full Setup)
4:24 – Test Checkout Using Connect Wallet (VESPR Wallet – Cardano ADA)
5:23 – Manual ADA Payment Checkout (VESPR Wallet Transfer Guide)
7:01 – WooCommerce Admin Dashboard: Cardano ADA Orders, Widget & Status Tracking

Thanks for watching! Now you know how to accept Cardano (ADA) payments in WooCommerce with a fully non-custodial setup.

If this helped you, don’t forget to like, subscribe, and turn on notifications for more crypto payment and Web3 WooCommerce tutorials.

See you in the next one 🚀
